scope: Retrospective same-batch anonymous seven-group classification using real uploaded spectra

source_dependency.selection: only the independently locked source-only neural-base champion; no final score choice
source_dependency.preprocessing: source-fitted SNV/StandardScaler/PCA as selected by the neural-base protocol; reused unchanged

adaptation.optimizer: SGD full-network on a copy; no momentum or weight decay
adaptation.source_CE: source-selected none/balanced weights; sum(weight_i*CE_i)/sum(weight_i); no resampling
adaptation.matched_zero: identical SGD/replay/proximal/steps with no target support loss; replay0 no-target is exact identity

comparators: same adaptation path without target supervision
selection.gate: proposed configuration passes both comparators on last2 tasks; otherwise untouched source
selection.seed_handling: all3 seeds averaged, no best-seed choice

execution_gate: development stage stops after lock; all current multiround development locks must exist before root starts any final evaluation
